# EdgeeTech

EdgeeTech Limited is a founder-led software engineering company registered in England & Wales (company number 12053376), based in Cambridge and London, UK. Founded in 2019 by Ahmet Selcuk Ozyurt.

## Services
- Software architecture and full-stack engineering: .NET, React/TypeScript, micro-frontends (single-spa, Module Federation), design systems, APIs.
- Cloud and DevOps: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes/Helm on EKS, CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Bitbucket Pipelines.
- AI-assisted engineering: adopting Claude Code in teams, MCP integrations, automated review, test generation, governance.
- Modernisation of legacy financial and enterprise systems.

## Products
- Taksim: closed as a commercial product in November 2026. Its predeclared benchmark tests showed that routing did not beat a fixed Sonnet default, and we honoured the result. The benchmark and docs pages stay online for reference; the code will be made public soon. Why: https://asozyurt.com/writing/closing-taksim/ Benchmark: https://taksim.edgee.tech/benchmark/
- Yuvuno: parent-managed private family photo sharing plus a separate kids' video catalogue; free, invite-only beta (Turkish-first, also English). https://yuvuno.com
- AgentBoard (source-available, Elastic License 2.0): https://github.com/edgeetech/agentboard
- Agent Workstation (open source, Windows desktop hub for specialist AI agents, maintenance mode): https://github.com/edgeetech/agentworkstation
- claude-notifier (MIT): https://github.com/edgeetech/claude-notifier
